path.data-text: Choose Start, Run, and type A:\SETUP.
Quill goes in C:\Program Files\Quill and in the Start
To remove it, use Add/Remove Programs.
Linux has no disk yet: build from the repository with Rust.
cargo install --path linux/quill-tty gives the terminal editor; cargo install --path
The Windows builds also run under Wine.
Removing Quill deletes only the files Setup installed. It leaves QUILL.INI, your dictionary
